dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Break time? Okay, I'll take a quick snooze. Relax, it's only a light nap, I can wake up whenever I want. It's my special trick for a quick recharge.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: You wanna learn? Hahaha, dream on! Once you've mastered "The Art of Light Sleeping," you'll never be able to sleep normally again!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: If you need to rest, you're better off getting a nice, deep sleep. Don't worry, I'll keep watch.
